I5.quote: Incorporation of highly extended π-conjugated molecules into conjugated microporous polymers (CMPs) is one of the important aspects in material science.

notes: Decisive point is I2. The sorbents are conjugated microporous polymers (CMP-G1, CMP-G2, and CMP-G1-x eq. in SI Table S1) synthesized by FeCl3 Scholl cyclodehydrogenation and oxidative polymerization at 40 °C (SI p. 6: 'After being stirred at 40 °C for 1 h'), then only degassed at 373 K before H2 measurement; no carbonization. They are majority carbon by formula (cyclized unit C66H18S6, about 79 wt% C, plus partial chlorination per IR) and the authors describe 'graphitic 3D network structures' and Raman D/G bands, but §3 states that uncarbonized polymers are not carbon sorbents, so no measured sorbent is a carbon sorbent. I1 (gravimetric IGA-001 at 77 K, SI p. 4), I3 (77 K, 1.0 and 20.0 bar, Table 1) and I4 (BET 997 and 786 m2/g) are met; I5 met. No not_primary, retracted or duplicate_data indication (record is_retracted false; no retraction or prior-publication statement in the PDF). The I1 uptake is an original measurement; SI states buoyancy correction with sorbate density 0.07 g/cm3 'to measure the absolute hydrogen isotherms'.
